name: UnifiedPush Troubleshooter
blurb: This application helps you troubleshoot your UnifiedPush setup.
description:
This application helps you troubleshoot your UnifiedPush setup. It allows you to list visible push services, try to connect to them and test it they can correctly forward you your notifications.

It is particularly useful to understand why an application using UnifiedPush doesn't receive push notification, and helps isolating the issue.

An UnifiedPush distributor, such as KUnifiedPush, must be installed.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
